Flexible Viewing with 360 Rotation: The ball-head mount allows 360 horizontal rotation and 90 tilt, so you can easily angle your projector or camera exactly where you need it - whether you're watching movies, presenting, recording, or streaming
Height Adjustable for Any Setup: Customize your viewing height from 36.6" to 48.75" using secure clamp-style knobs that lock firmly in place. Adjust in seconds to match your sofa, desk, or bed height

Sleek, Minimalist L-Shape Design: Designed to blend effortlessly into modern homes and offices. The slim L-shaped stand fits neatly behind sofas, beds, or furniture, helping you save space while keeping your setup clean and stylish
